programs.title: Parasite
programs.desc: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

programs.title: Heated Rivalry
programs.desc: Shane and Ilya keep their secret fling alive while their growing connection is tested by personal and professional pressures.

programs.title: White Noise
programs.desc: Ava's debilitating hyper-sensitivity to sound is becoming unliveable. When an attempt at suicide fails, she pleads with her doctor to enrol her in an experimental trial involving an anechoic chamber: the world's quietest room.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.sub_title: One Flew Over My Dead Body
programs.desc: Karen and Davis discover a mannequin dumped in the woods and try to solve the crime; at Corner Gas, Brent surprises Wanda with a scanner; in The Ruby, Lacey, Oscar, Hank, and Emma get drawn into an unusual bet about hand sanitizer.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: Emma sees high art in Hank's hedge-trimming and sells his services around town; prompted by Oscar, Brent tries to collect on the IOUs piling up at Corner Gas, resorting to unorthodox means; Davis and Karen set up the cop shop in The Ruby.

programs.title: Transplant
programs.desc: With his future as a doctor on the line, Bash must suppress his instincts and avoid any chance of risk.

programs.title: Solemates
programs.desc: A love triangle between a shoe store owner, a customer and an old pair of shoes. When Andrew walks into William's store to replace his own worn old pair of brogues, interest is piqued.

programs.title: Paws in the City
programs.desc: A woman lands a job caring for a dachshund diva whose bark is worse than her bite, much like the dog's reclusive and handsome owner. What starts as a way to keep a roof over her head soon turns into an opportunity for lifelong success and love.

programs.title: My Penguin Friend
programs.desc: A heartbroken fisherman finds a penguin drifting alone in the ocean, drenched in oil from a spill. He not only rescues the sea creature, but takes it under his wing, finding a sense of joy for the first time in years.

programs.title: Gone Mom: The Disappearance of Jennifer Dulos
programs.desc: Police investigate Fotis Dulos when his wife, Jennifer, mysteriously disappears after driving their five children to school.

programs.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programs.desc: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with a powerful faction of Transformers known as the Maximals to save Earth.

programs.title: Air Bud: Golden Receiver
programs.desc: Teenager Josh (Kevin Zegers) just became the legal owner of his basketball-playing dog, Buddy. But now Buddy is playing football, too, thanks to veterinarian Patrick Sullivan (Gregory Harrison), who happens to be the new boyfriend of Josh's mom. Unfortunately, Josh and Patrick don't get along too well. But, when a couple of Russians (Nora Dunn, Perry Anzilotti) see Buddy playing on TV and decide to kidnap him for their circus, the two must band together to find the dog and save him.
